notes: References were computed from complete raw builtin observations after real builtin-import API calls.
EDSS-CFA is used as a data sample for EFA; no CFA runtime claim.
ML factanal and explicit full-profile ULS compare equivalent unrotated reproduced correlations.
Polychoric uses psych global=TRUE, correct=0, smooth=FALSE.
Choice full likelihood and CR1 use 96 respondents, 1152 tasks, 3456 alternatives; no pooled-row logistic model.
Initial exploratory choice coefficient tolerance 1e-6 and probability tolerance 1e-7 were too strict for normalized-score stopping at1e-6. Independent score validation confirms accepted residual.
Census svychisq statistic=F uses ids=~1, weights=~MARSUPWT, independent respondents with no strata/PSU fields. svymean SE is recorded as reference context; scalar summary API currently exposes no SE.
